title: Added AI chat referral source to website forms
summary: Added a ChatGPT / AI chat option to every referral-source dropdown across quote, service, neighborhood, marketplace pickup, and careers forms.
impact: Helps Comfort Moving Chicago identify leads and applicants who discovered the company through AI chat tools.
ownerNote: The existing CRM form script already sends referralSource, so submissions choosing ChatGPT / AI chat will flow through with the rest of the lead data.

title: Published privacy policy and linked it on lead forms
summary: Added a plain-language privacy policy covering the custom CRM, operational-only use, no data sharing, SMS opt-out, and indefinite retention. Quote and application forms now display a link immediately below their submit controls.
impact: Gives prospective customers a clear explanation of how submitted information is handled before they send a request.
